title: Apollo crew followed by something to the Moon
summary: James Fox tells of Apollo crew followed by something to the Moon, about 1969 at The Moon, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he had told her was that they were followed by something to the Moon
She also told me that he had some UFO encounter on the way to the moon.
tellings.difference: Calls it a UFO encounter of Aldrin's own rather than the crew being followed.
tellings.link_reason: In both, Fay Ann Potter relays that Buzz Aldrin met something on the way to the Moon in 1969.

as_told.title: Buzz Aldrin's UFO encounter on the way to the Moon
as_told.place_text: Space, en route to the Moon

tellings.quote: Apollo 11's so weird. Uh because you have Buzz Aldrin openly admitting in multiple interviews that you had this thing following them
tellings.difference: Says Aldrin admitted it openly in several interviews, where the story has it through his sister Fay Ann Potter.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of something following the Apollo 11 crew on the way to the Moon, as told by Aldrin.

as_told.title: Buzz Aldrin's Apollo 11 object following the spacecraft
